description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to register indexing services, sources, and handlers within the OrchardCore framework, facilitating dependency injection configuration for indexing components.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to register indexing-related services and handlers.

methods.name: AddIndexingCore
methods.description: Registers core indexing services such as task manager, profile manager, profile store, and handlers.

methods.name: AddIndexingSource
methods.description: Registers an indexing source with specified manager, document manager, and naming provider, and adds it to indexing options.

methods.name: AddIndexingSource (generic with TOptions)
methods.description: Registers an indexing source with additional options, only if the provider configuration exists.

methods.name: AddIndexingSourceServices
methods.description: Registers scoped services for a specific indexing source identified by provider name.

methods.name: AddIndexProfileHandler
methods.description: Registers an index profile handler implementation.
